newsitem.title: USA: Trident Rowan says Tamarix buys shares.
newsitem.headline: Trident Rowan says Tamarix buys shares.

text.p: Trident Rowan Group Inc said on Thursday that Tamarix Investors Ldc had bought 900,000 shares of the company's common stock for $7.75 a share from Finprogetti SpA.
In addition, Trident said, Tamarix had acquired a proxy to vote and a right to purchase the remaining 735,000 shares owned by Finprogetti, making Tamarix the company's largest stockholder.
In connection with the purchase, four board members designated by Finprogetti resigned and three new members designated by Tamarix were elected, Trident said in a statement.
Trident Rowan Group Inc specializes in management interventions in troubled companies.
